speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
text: asked the Minister for Health (a) whether the statistics for 2021 shows an increasing trend in the number of people using vaporisers; and (b) amongst the users which consist of school-going youths and children, which age group and education level saw the highest number of vaporiser users.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: This worrying trend of increased vaping is also observed internationally.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: In response, MOH will work together with relevant partners and stakeholders to strengthen enforcement measures, as well as enhance public education efforts.
